edits.before: Q through two units on every last-hit — each stack is permanent AP; the lane is a savings account from level 1.
edits.after: His 850-range Bouncing Bomb out-ranges your Q at level 1 — take last-hits from max range and eat no free poke.

edits.before: W on cage-stunned or rooted targets only — uncaged Dark Matter is a donation to his dodge stats.
edits.after: At 2 Satchel Charge shoves the wave and denies your walk-up — hold W for targets your cage has stopped.

edits.before: Cage online: drop it ON yourself when he engages, behind him when he farms — the geometry does the fighting.
edits.after: Level 3 his layered Q-W poke chunks you before you reach 725 E range — self-cage, don't chase the trade.

edits.before: Lost Chapter timing — Q-stack on cooldown and double-stack off cannon waves. The curve is the matchup.
edits.after: Through 4-5 he free-pokes from outside your reach — Q-stack off cannon waves and hold even CS to 6.

edits.before: Luden's spike: cage-W-Q-R deletes squishies who touch the wall. Your zone is a courtroom now.
edits.after: Lost Chapter: one landed E-W-Q chunks more than his Q bounce ever will — punish his W cooldown.

edits.before: Ziggs wins by landing Satchel Charge, denying your pattern, and keeping the fight at a distance your kit resents.
edits.after: Ziggs wins by out-ranging you with Bouncing Bomb, satcheling out of your cage, and sieging towers you can't defend.

edits.before: - Ziggs Satchel Charge: matchup-defining — His knockback escape — he is catchable only while it is down. It governs your forward steps. - E Event Horizon (self-cage) spent on poke is a death you scheduled. - Hold the R for the fight that decides something.
edits.after: - Satchel Charge (W) is 20s at rank 1, 12s max — his only escape; he is catchable exactly in that window. - His combo opens with a Short Fuse auto reset: the wind-up, not the cast, is your step-back cue. - E spent on poke is a death you scheduled.

edits.before: Cage his step-up, W the edge-stun, Q-auto, and walk — a half-bar trade that also deposited three stacks into the curve.
edits.after: He must step inside 850 to bomb you — cage that lane, and the edge-stun buys the full W-Q chunk his Satchel can't refuse.

edits.before: W-ing open ground on a moving target and trading uncaged 'just to stack' — Veigar without the wall is a piggy bank with a hat.
edits.after: His Q clears on a 6s-to-4s cooldown and his mines cover the wave — a shove war is free poke for him; take stacks, step out.

edits.before: Ziggs out-ranges you at level 1 with his Q short-fuse bounce.
edits.after: Ziggs out-ranges you at level 1 with his 850-range Q bounce.

edits.before: Levels 1-2 go to Ziggs: his Q short-fuse out-ranges everything you have and his W shoves you off the wave, so just farm at max range and eat as little poke as you can.
edits.after: Levels 1-2 go to Ziggs: his Bouncing Bomb (Q) out-ranges everything you have and his W shoves you off the wave, so farm at max range and eat as little poke as you can.
